notes: Archived and deprecated (moved to vercel/shop). pnpm per README, pnpm-lock.yaml (v9) and .vscode/launch.json; no packageManager field and no CI. The env must hold real Shopify values: SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN (with the [placeholder] brackets removed, which lib/utils.ts checks) and SHOPIFY_STOREFRONT_ACCESS_TOKEN from a Shopify store. Every page fetches from the Shopify Storefront API, so nothing renders without them. SHOPIFY_REVALIDATION_SECRET only matters for webhooks; COMPANY_NAME/SITE_NAME have defaults. The README's numbered route is the Vercel CLI (`vercel env pull`, which writes .env.local in current CLI versions), but it also says a .env file is enough. No local backing services: Shopify is a hosted external API. No Node version is stated.
